name: What materials are best for non-slip exterior pathways?

mainEntity.name: What materials are best for non-slip exterior pathways?

acceptedAnswer.text: For non-slip exterior pathways, several materials and treatments are effective. Textured concrete, pavers with rough finishes, or natural stone with a slightly abrasive surface are good choices. Non-slip coatings, often acrylic or epoxy-based with aggregate added, can be applied to existing concrete or wood surfaces. Rubber pavers or mats are also options for specific areas requiring high traction. The best material depends on the pathway's location, expected foot traffic, aesthetic preferences, and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Textured concrete, rough-finish pavers, natural stone, or applied non-slip coatings with aggregate are good choices for reducing slips. Rubber options also exist.
